name: Jeroboam
summary: A king of Israel, the son of Joash, who reigned forty-one years from Samaria. He did evil, yet the LORD used him to rescue Israel and win back its borders.

key_moments.title: Restores Israel's Borders
key_moments.description: The LORD saw how bitter Israel's suffering was, and saved them through Jeroboam. He won back land from Hamath to the Sea of the Plain, as the LORD had said through the prophet Jonah.

key_moments.title: Warned by Amos
key_moments.description: The prophet Amos said the LORD would rise against Jeroboam's house with the sword. The priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam that Amos was plotting against him.
